_about: Objective BACKING measurement for the WS2 architectural-grammar GAP review (2026-06-15). NOT a pixel-similarity instrument — the frames are different camera framings (see report method caveat). These are STRUCTURE-DISTRIBUTION proxies that BACK the manual PRESENCE/COHERENCE rubric (Discipline #4 — manual architectural-grammar read is the gate; these numbers corroborate, they do not score). Generated by pipeline/arch-grammar-band-probe.mjs.
_thr: Sobel gradient-magnitude edge threshold = 40 (separates built-structure edges from texture noise). upper band = top third of frame (where an iso-ARPG raised gallery storey reads); lower band = bottom two-thirds (fighting floor). arcade-rhythm = count of periodic peaks in the upper-band per-column edge profile (120-bin) via autocorrelation > 0.2 — a regular colonnade/arcade/balustrade produces periodic side-lobes; scattered verticals do not.

reference_summary.arcadeRhythm_periodicPeaks_range: 0-4 (mean ~1.6; 5 of 8 frames >=1; the cathedral/timber/graveyard frames show 2-4 — a measurable built rhythm)
reference_summary.note: storeyRatio is NOT a clean discriminator (ref spans 0.60-1.24) because the reference also carries dense lower-floor dressing; this is exactly why the review is a manual PRESENCE/COHERENCE read, not an edge-density read.

our_iter3_summary.arcadeRhythm_periodicPeaks_range: 0-1 (5 of 6 frames = 0; only zone2 = 1). NO built rhythm — consistent with scattered verticals / no arcade / no balustrade.
our_iter3_summary.interpretation: edge densities are HIGH (often above reference) because our dense floor+perimeter dressing clutter generates edges — but the clutter is NOT organized into a periodic built rhythm. The probe corroborates: we have BUSYNESS, not BUILT-COHERENCE. The absence of periodic peaks across the corpus is the objective backing for the (a) load-path and (b) arcade gap reads.
